bio: Seating just 12 diners, this compact restaurant in the centre of Nauders is accommodated in a 400-year-old traditional Alpine family room, now part of Alpen-Comfort-Hotel Central. The space exudes cosiness with warm wood throughout – from the lovely wooden floorboards to the walls and coffered ceiling – plus a charming tiled stove and traditional decoration. Creating a striking contrast to the historical surroundings, the modern cuisine is prepared by the team around owner Michael Michi Ploner and chef Oliver Mijic. You won't find a regular menu here; rather, guests are presented with a series of caricatures – and guessing their meaning is part of the experience.
